title: quassia crocea
intro: Quassia crocea, commonly known as the Yellow Quassia or Quassia Amara, is a medicinal plant belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits such as treating digestive issues, parasitic infections, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Quassia crocea include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural insecticide. The bioactive constituents of this plant include quassin, limonoids, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
